description: This file implements the ResourceManager class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, handling resource control functions such as blocking audio/video applications and reserving TTS resources, with external dependencies on other modules and JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Main class managing resource control, including AV blocking and TTS reservation, with JSON-RPC registration and external resource management.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Helper class for making JSON-RPC calls to other services, used internally for TTS resource management.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets the AV blocked status for a given application ID.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of applications currently blocked from AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resource for a specific application ID.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for multiple applications.
